title: Digital Content Developer (Junior)
company: MP Jobs Ltd t/a MP Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
advertiser_name: MP Jobs Ltd t/a MP Recruitment Group
description:
Oxfordshire Hybrid Working Full Time

Launch Your Career in Digital Learning

Are you a creative digital content professional looking to take the next step in your career? Do you enjoy transforming ideas into engaging digital experiences and want to develop your skills in eLearning and multimedia design?

We're recruiting for a Junior Digital Content Developer to join a collaborative and supportive team where you'll work alongside experienced developers, receive ongoing mentoring and have the opportunity to progress into a more senior role as your skills develop.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong digital, creative or learning content background who is keen to learn new technologies and build a long-term career within digital learning.

The Role

Working as part of a growing digital learning team, you'll support the design and development of engaging, accessible digital learning content for a wide range of clients. You'll collaborate with experienced colleagues and subject matter experts to create interactive learning experiences using a variety of creative tools and technologies.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the design and development of engaging digital learning content.
- Create multimedia assets including graphics, illustrations, video, animation and interactive content.
- Work with subject matter experts to turn complex information into engaging, easy-to-understand digital content.
- Assist in developing eLearning modules using tools such as Articulate Storyline 360 and Rise 360 (full training provided where required).
- Carry out quality assurance testing to ensure content is accurate, accessible and user-friendly.
- Support the publishing and maintenance of learning content through Learning Management Systems.
- Contribute ideas to improve digital learning experiences, creative design and development processes.
- Support demonstrations, prototypes and other digital learning projects.

About You

We're looking for someone with a creative mindset, strong attention to detail and a genuine interest in digital learning.

You may come from a background in:
- Digital Content Creation
- Graphic Design
- Multimedia Design
- Marketing or Creative Content
- Learning & Development
- Instructional or Educational Content
- Digital Media or Web Content

You'll ideally have:
- Strong visual design and digital content creation skills.
- Experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro or After Effects.
- Experience creating multimedia content such as graphics, video, animation, web content or interactive assets.
- The ability to interpret complex information and present it in a clear, engaging way.
- Excellent attention to detail and a quality-focused approach.
- Strong communication skills and confidence working with colleagues, clients or subject matter experts.
- Good technical aptitude and enthusiasm for learning new software and technologies.

Experience with Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, SCORM, Learning Management Systems, accessibility standards, UX design, HTML/CSS, Moodle or WordPress would be beneficial but is not essential, as training and mentoring will be provided.

What's on Offer
- Hybrid working in Oxfordshire
- Ongoing mentoring from experienced Digital Content Developers
- Structured training and career development
- Opportunity to progress into a Senior Digital Content Developer role
- Collaborative and supportive working environment
- Company pension and additional benefits

This role would suit someone with strong transferable creative skills who is eager to develop their technical expertise and build a rewarding career within digital learning.

We are committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion in the workplace. Applications are welcomed from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

title: Ecommerce & Trading Assistant
company: Helen and Douglas House - Agency - Permanent
description:
Ecommerce & Trading Assistant

We're looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Ecommerce & Trading Assistant to support our growing commercial retail operation. This is a varied and hands-on role, ideal for someone who enjoys working with products, systems, and people, and wants to help raise vital funds for Helen & Douglas House.

You'll be involved in everything from sourcing new goods/bought in goods and preparing stock to coordinating with our logistics & shop teams and ensuring our online customers receive a smooth and positive shopping experience, on ecommerce platforms like eBay.

Key Responsibilities:
- Product Sourcing, Preparation & Listing
- Assist in sourcing new goods
- Prepare items for listing including photographing stock
- Support with writing accurate and appealing product descriptions
- Stock Management
- Accept and check deliveries of donated and new goods
- Barcode and organise stock
- Pick and pack items for dispatch
- Logistics & Coordination
- Liaise with the logistics team to ensure timely dispatch and delivery
- Help maintain accurate stock records and inventory systems
- Team Support
- Work closely with our amazing commercial team to support our ecommerce operation and our portfolio of shops
- Contribute ideas to improve efficiency and customer experience

Skills & Experience:
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Experience with ecommerce platforms - eBay and/or other resale platforms
- Experience of the circular economy/sustainable fashion/second hand market
- Experience in buying or visual merchandising, customer service experience
- Good written communication and basic photography skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Passion for retail, charity work, and creative storytelling.

Ready to bring your skills to a role that matters? apply now

Job details:
- Hours: 37.5 hours per week
- Location: Oxford (OX4 6 JS)
- Salary: £25,087 per annum
- Closing date: 11st September 2026 at 12 noon

We reserve the right to close the advert at any time should we receive sufficient applications, therefore weencourageapplicants to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that everyone working for Helen & Douglas House are required to undertake a Disclosure and Barring Service check. Helen & Douglas House is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. We are an equal opportunities employer and value the benefits of a diverse workforce. We positively encourage applications from all areas of the community.

title: Email Campaign Executive
description:
Ready to make your mark in digital marketing?

If you love getting stuck into email campaigns, spotting what makes a subject line work, and turning data into decisions, this could be your next big move.

An exciting opportunity has opened up for an Email Campaign Executive to join a well-established manufacturer in the safety equipment sector, based in Oxfordshire. This is a genuinely international business, and this role puts you right at the centre of how they communicate with their global distribution network.

You'll take ownership of email marketing campaigns from planning through to reporting, working closely with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across multiple regions. It's a role with real variety, real responsibility, and real opportunity to grow.

On offer is a salary of £27,000 plus a bonus of up to £2,000 a year, paid quarterly based on sales targets. You'll also get 25 days holiday, an employer-matched pension, a personal development plan, Perkbox discounts, a wellbeing programme, and a cycle-to-work scheme. The role is office-based (with WFH one day a week once you're through probation), so you'll need your own transport to get there.

Key Responsibilities:
- Plan, build and send email campaigns for the company's global distribution network
- Manage a global campaign calendar so every send lands on time
- Build targeted campaigns around customer needs and business goals
- Create and manage automated journeys, nurture campaigns and lead generation
- Work closely with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across different regions
- Keep the marketing database clean and GDPR-compliant
- Run A/B tests to keep improving campaign performance
- Track KPIs and turn the numbers into clear, actionable insight
- Make sure every campaign matches company brand guidelines and technical accuracy
- Support event promotion and follow-up lead nurturing
- Spot opportunities to improve automation, reporting and campaign efficiency

Skills & Experience:
- 2+ years' experience in email marketing, campaign management or marketing automation
- Experience in a B2 B marketing environment
- Confident with CRM systems and customer data
- Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms and automation tools
- Comfortable analysing performance data and turning it into recommendations
- Experience building campaign reports and dashboards
- Sharp attention to detail and solid project management skills
- Strong written communication and copywriting ability
- Able to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines at once
- A team player who's used to working across marketing, sales and product
- Bonus points for experience with international markets or multi-language campaigns

How to Apply:

This is a genuine chance to grow your marketing career inside an established, international manufacturer, with training, support and real ownership from day one. If you're re ady to take the next step, apply now or contact Niche Recruitment with any questions.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Oxfordshire

£30-40k

VR/10568

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a skilled Marketing Executive to join a successful and well-established company based in Oxfordshire, who are part of a large international group. They are now embarking on an exciting phase of growth and this is a new role to help increase their impact and reach.

This role is perfect for an all round marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building from the ground up.

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the Marketing Executive will primarily focus on D2 C and B2 B funnels optimisation. Your work will directly contribute to brand awareness, lead generation, and revenue growth.

Your role will involve:
- Brand - Keep consistency within the company's core brand values, tone, and visual identity across all customer-facing assets (website, social media, email, print, etc.).
- Campaigns and Email Marketing - Develop, execute, and optimise multi-channel campaigns (email, social, paid, organic) to drive conversion.
- A/B test subject lines, CTAs, and content to refine performance.
- SEO, Content and Design - Create and optimise landing pages, blog posts,and marketing collateral.
- Conduct keyword research and implement on-page SEO best practices (meta tags, headers, internal linking) to improve organic search rankings.
- Design on marketing materials (social posts,brochures, presentations) using brand guidelines
- Social media - Manage and grow the company's presence on LinkedIn (B2 B) and Instagram (D2 C and B2 B), tailoring content for each audience.
- Events - Coordinate with event partners to ensure seamless execution of conferences and planned activities
- CRM - Maintain data hygiene in the CRM (e.g., deduplication, missing information, tagging)
- Performance Marketing - Collect, visualise, and interpret performance data to inform decisions.

You will be the ideal candidate due to your:
- Previous marketing experience in B2 C and/or B2 B.
- Marketing generalist mindset: Comfortable wearing multiple hats and adapting to evolving priorities
- Strong content marketing and storytelling skills: Ability to craft SEO-optimised narratives for diverse audiences.
- Data-driven decision-making: Proficient in analysing metrics (GA4, CRM reports and more) to optimise campaigns.
- Proactive and autonomous.
- Growth mindset: Curious, resourceful, and always seeking to learn and improve.
- Hands-on CRM experience.

Desirable
- HubSpot knowledge and/or certification
- Canva or designing tools (Adobe Suite, Figma)
- Brevo or other email marketing tools
- E-commerce platform i.e Shopify
- SEO/SEM knowledge: Basic understanding of technical SEO, backlinking, and paid search strategies
- Project Management: Ability to juggle multiple deadlines.

title: Temporary Marketing Account Manager
description:
Are you an experienced marketing professional looking for a temporary role where you can make an immediate impact? This is an exciting opportunity to support a leading organisation within the horticulture sector during a busy period, helping coordinate key events and campaigns with minimal onboarding.

Please note, this is a temporary position paid on a weekly PAYE basis and will require an immediate start, notice periods cannot be accommodated.

Temporary Marketing Account Manager Responsibilities
This position will involve, but will not be limited to:
- Managing multiple marketing projects, ensuring deadlines are met and outputs are delivered to a high standard.
- Planning and delivering materials for high-profile events, including content capture and event support during the conferences and awards.
- Liaising with printers and suppliers to produce print materials, ensuring specifications are met and proofreading is accurate.
- Supporting social media and content creation during events, including live posting and capturing vox pops.
- Coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders to maintain project momentum.
- Assisting with email marketing campaigns and CRM management to support event promotion.
- Attending events and visits as required, supporting logistical and operational needs.

Temporary Marketing Account Manager Rewards
- Flexibility to work from home 2 days a week once trained
- Opportunities to support major events
- Occasional travel for events

The Company
Our client's culture is built on teamwork, inclusion, and trust, with a focus on innovation and member support. This is a fantastic environment for someone looking to gain valuable event and project management experience.

Temporary Marketing Project Executive/Manager Experience Essentials
- Proven experience in managing marketing projects, ideally within an agency, events, or marketing operations setting.
- Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
- Excellent communication and proofreading skills, particularly with print materials.
- Experience supporting social media during events and creating engaging content in real time.
- Familiarity with email automation and CRM platforms.
- Confidence liaising directly with printers and suppliers.
- Calm under pressure and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
- Valid driver s licence and access to own vehicle, as travel expenses will be reimbursed.

Location
Based in Didcot with regular presence in the office at least three days a week. Transport links are limited, so own transport is essential. There is onsite parking available. Occasional travel to events and sites will be required; all travel costs will be reimbursed.

Action
If you would like to find out more about this excellent opportunity, then please apply online today. We will review and respond to all applications.
